answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the delta of free entry disappears, the pulse of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the vault case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while duplicates get dearer.
